sims.title: What if gravity switched off for 5 seconds?
sims.caption:
What if gravity switched off for 5 seconds? You wouldn't float. The whole planet would spring outward under your feet, and you'd feel nothing until gravity came back. 🌍

Follow for a new simulation every day.

#whatif #simulation #science #physics #gravity #studytok #space
sims.science: Earth is in balance between gravity and internal pressure. Remove gravity and every layer (rock, sea, air) accelerates outward at the local g, so the ground keeps pushing on your feet as before. After 5 s: v = 9.81*5 = 49 m/s = 176 km/h, rise = 0.5*9.81*25 = 123 m. Pressure at the centre about 364 GPa = 3.6 million atm. When gravity returns the outward motion continues and the planet oscillates (radial mode period about 20 minutes).

sims.title: Chernobyl, second by second
sims.caption:
Chernobyl, second by second. 36 seconds after the test began, the operators hit the shutdown button, and for a moment it made things worse. This is the physics of why. ☢️

Follow for a new simulation every day.

#chernobyl #simulation #science #physics #radioactivity #history #studytok
sims.science: Test began 01:23:04, AZ-5 pressed 01:23:40 (36 s later), explosions about 01:23:44-48. RBMK: positive void coefficient, graphite-tipped control rods. Power estimated at around 100 times nominal. Upper shield about 1,000 t. I-131 half-life 8 days, Cs-137 30 years. Graphite fire about 10 days.
